title: LLM Evaluators Recognize and Favor Their Own Generations

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise comparisons and individual Likert-scale ratings of text summaries, measuring whether an LLM evaluator assigns higher scores to its own generated outputs compared to outputs generated by other LLMs or humans.
Swapping the presentation sequence of options in pairwise evaluation prompts and calculating the percentage of times the LLM reverses its preference based purely on the order of presentation.
